sentences.text: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to Large Industries and Thrust Sector: EPF Reimbursement

**Scheme Brief Description:** The "Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to Large Industries and Thrust Sector" aims to provide incentives to attract increased investments in the manufacturing sector to create more employment opportunities in Gujarat.
**Who is this for:** Business Entity, Industries; Category: Business & Entrepreneurship; Sector: Setting up / start-up / entrepreneurship

**Detailed Description:** The &quot;Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to Large Industries and Thrust Sector&quot; is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines Department, Gujarat. It aims to empower the state&#39;s dynamic large-industry sector, which significantly contributes to employment, GDP, and exports. Effective from October 5, 2022, to October 4, 2027, this initiative supports growth, investments, and the vision of &quot;Aatmanirbhar Gujarat&quot; and &quot;Aatmanirbhar Bharat.&quot; The component &quot;EPF Reimbursement&quot; offers financial assistance to eligible large industrial undertakings in Gujarat for the employer’s contribution to the Employees&#39; Provident Fund (EPF) for new employees. This assistance is available for a maximum period of 10 years from the date of commencement of commercial production.

**Benefits / Assistance:** - **Full reimbursement of employer’s contribution:** 100% of the employer’s statutory EPF contribution will be reimbursed for eligible new employees. - **Financial ceiling per employee:** The reimbursement amount is limited to 12% of the employee’s basic salary plus Dearness Allowance (DA) and retaining allowance, or ₹1800/- per month, whichever is lower. - **Long-term support:** The reimbursement is available for a period of up to 10 years from the date of commencement of commercial production.

**Exclusions / Not eligible:** - An eligible industrial undertaking that has availed EPF reimbursement under any scheme of the central / state government, or any agency of the central/ state government, shall not be eligible for EPF incentive under this scheme for that period.

**Application Process:** > **Registration Process:** **Step-1:** Visit the [Investor Facilitation Portal (IFP)](https://ifp.gujarat.gov.in/DIGIGOV/) portal. Click on "New Investor Registration" to access the registration form. **Step-2:** Fill in the Registration Form. Click on "Submit". **Step-3:** Verify the E-mail ID using the link sent on your registered E-mail ID. **Step-4:** After verification, you will be registered successfully.  > **Post-Registration Process:** **Step-1:** Visit the [Investor Facilitation Portal (IFP)](https://ifp.gujarat.gov.in/DIGIGOV/) portal. Click on "Login". **Step-2:** Enter the email address and password you used during registration. **Step-3:** Click the "Login" button to access your account. **Step-4:** Now fill in the required details and mandatory documents about your business to complete the application process.  > **Helpdesk****:** [Contact Here](https://ifp.gujarat.gov.in/DIGIGOV/IFP-pages/contact.jsp?pagedisp=static)
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Industries and Mines Department
